title: Password Age and Reuse Audit
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=breach:alert event=account_inventory
| eval age_days=round((now()-last_changed)/86400,0)
| stats latest(age_days) as age, latest(reused) as reused by account
| where age>365 OR reused="true"
| sort - age
description: Surfaces accounts with old or reused passwords, the ones most worth updating in your manager.
value: Old and reused passwords are the weakest links; a targeted list makes a password refresh quick and high-impact.
implementation: Ingest password-manager metadata into `index=personal`; flag stale or reused passwords.
visualization: Table of accounts with old or reused passwords.
grandmaExplanation: It finds accounts with old or repeated passwords, the ones most worth updating to stay safe.
